statements.query: MATCH (keyring:GCPKMSKeyRing{exposed_internet:true})<-[r:RESOURCE]-(location:GCPLocation)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WITH keyring LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE keyring.exposed_internet, keyring.exposed_internet_type return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: The WHERE matters: an iterative statement stops at the first batch with no updates, so without it only the first LIMIT_SIZE keys were ever reset.
statements.query: MATCH (crypto_key:GCPKMSCryptoKey)<-[r:RESOURCE]-(keyring:GCPKMSKeyRing)<-[:RESOURCE]-(location:GCPLocation)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE crypto_key.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL OR crypto_key.exposed_internet_type IS NOT NULL WITH crypto_key LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE crypto_key.exposed_internet, crypto_key.exposed_internet_type return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: Key ring IAM binding (any role) to allUsers / allAuthenticatedUsers.
statements.query:
MATCH (binding:GCPBinding)<-[a:ATTACHED_BINDING]-(keyring:GCPKMSKeyRing)<-[r:RESOURCE]-(location:GCPLocation)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})
UNWIND [m IN binding.members WHERE m IN ['allUsers', 'allAuthenticatedUsers']] AS member
SET keyring.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT member IN coalesce(keyring.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN keyring END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(keyring.exposed_internet_type, []) + member

statements.__comment: A crypto key is public through its key ring's policy (inherited) or its own IAM policy (any role) granting allUsers / allAuthenticatedUsers.
statements.query:
MATCH (crypto_key:GCPKMSCryptoKey)<-[r:RESOURCE]-(keyring:GCPKMSKeyRing)<-[:RESOURCE]-(location:GCPLocation)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})
WITH crypto_key, coalesce(keyring.exposed_internet_type, []) + reduce(acc = [], members IN [(crypto_key)-[:ATTACHED_BINDING]->(b:GCPBinding) | b.members] | acc + members) AS members
UNWIND [m IN members WHERE m IN ['allUsers', 'allAuthenticatedUsers']] AS member
SET crypto_key.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT member IN coalesce(crypto_key.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN crypto_key END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(crypto_key.exposed_internet_type, []) + member
